about: Step 1B PR 7c2 answer key, written by the answer-key author. Every figure, name and text is invented. Computed with fractions.Fraction and hashlib by make_pr7c2.py (not the code under test), which loads the 7c1, 7a2 and 7b oracles by path. A row is the 7c1 row shape: `source` (CP-2G or CP-1), a `foundation` document and a `forward` document (null on layer 1), each a fixture `file` with text `edits` and block `ops` (see pr7c1.json). `expected` lists both hashes, currency, scale, spans, stress basis, cases (each year a list in the order of `fields`; an amount is amount_text, a missing value is {missing: ...}), the facility detail and every limit in order. Implementers do not edit this file.

NC_EBITDA: Not calculable: EBITDA is zero or negative (ZERO_OR_NEGATIVE_DENOMINATOR)
NC_INTEREST: Not calculable: cash interest is zero or negative (ZERO_OR_NEGATIVE_DENOMINATOR)
NC_DEBT: Not calculable: debt is zero or negative (ZERO_OR_NEGATIVE_DENOMINATOR)
NEGATIVE_CASH: Not calculable: cash is negative before funding
